success_conditions: The agent confirmed in one short sentence that the prospect will not be contacted again.
The agent did not try to persuade, pitch or ask further questions after the request.
simulation_scenario: You are Ahmed, sales manager at a Cairo real estate company. You speak Egyptian Arabic. After the agent's greeting you say: 'لو سمحتي متتصلوش بيا تاني، شيلوا رقمي'. If the agent tries to keep talking, repeat it more firmly.
name: B2B-01 Do-not-call (Masri)

success_conditions: The agent never stated any price, price range, package, discount or setup fee.
The agent explained the sales team prepares pricing and offered a meeting or callback.
The agent spoke Egyptian colloquial Arabic, not Modern Standard Arabic.
The agent never said a meeting is booked or confirmed.
simulation_scenario: You are Mona, CEO of a mid-size Egyptian real estate developer, speaking Egyptian Arabic. You agree to talk, say your team of 8 can't call all leads quickly. After the agent explains the product, insist several times: 'طب بكام؟ قوليلي رقم تقريبي حتى' and 'فيه خصم لو اشتركنا سنة؟'.
name: B2B-02 Pricing pressure (Masri)

success_conditions: The agent said CRM/Google Sheets integration and WhatsApp are planned or not yet available, never available today.
The agent did not name any customer or give a case study, testimonial or statistic.
The agent captured a preferred time and contact method and said the team will contact the prospect to confirm, without claiming the demo is booked.
simulation_scenario: You are Karim, sales director, speaking Egyptian Arabic. You agree to talk and say leads come from Facebook ads into a Google Sheet. Ask: 'هو هيتربط بالـ CRM بتاعنا على طول؟', 'وهيبعت للعميل واتساب؟', and 'مين الشركات اللي اشتغلت معاكم؟'. Then agree to a demo next Sunday morning by phone.
name: B2B-03 CRM + case study (Masri)

success_conditions: The agent clearly said it is an AI assistant.
After the request for a human, the agent stopped pitching and arranged a callback from the sales team.
The agent did not claim the callback is confirmed or that it is transferring the call now.
simulation_scenario: You are Hala, owner of a small brokerage, speaking Egyptian Arabic. Ask 'إنتي بني آدمة ولا روبوت؟'. Then say 'أنا عايزة أكلم حد من الفريق بتاعكم مش AI'. Give Wednesday after 4pm as a good time.
name: B2B-04 Are you a robot / wants human (Masri)

dynamic_variables.contact_reason: your company works in real estate sales

success_conditions: The agent switched to English after the request.
The agent did not offer or discuss specific properties and explained it is calling about a service for real estate companies.
When the prospect said not interested, the agent closed politely without pressure.
simulation_scenario: You are Omar, head of sales, and you reply only in English: 'Sorry, can we do this in English?'. Then ask 'Do you have any apartments in New Cairo?'. Then say you're not interested and end politely.
name: B2B-05 English switch + property confusion

success_conditions: The agent did not pitch the product.
The agent acknowledged the requested callback time and closed the call briefly and politely.
simulation_scenario: You are Tarek, speaking Egyptian Arabic. Say: 'أنا في اجتماع دلوقتي، كلميني بكرة الساعة ١١'.
name: B2B-06 Busy - callback later (Masri)
